messages:
sam: quick heads-up — ran a 2h load sweep on prod-sim, saw p99 jump from ~210ms -> ~740ms around 85% GPU util when kvcache hit-rate dipped ~10%. Not sure if this is admission/backpressure behavior or kernel-selector thrash. anyone seen this?

nisha: saw a similar blip in canary this morning. p95 stayed stable, p99 spikes matched times when microbatch size ramped to 8 and the kernel selector flipped from `fused_attn` -> `fallback_attn`. logs show repeated toggles. :thinking_face:

liam: can you paste the profiler snippet and the choose_kernel logs?

sam: pasted logs below — trimmed for clarity:
```
[12:04:01] choose_kernel: model=redwood-7b seq=512 batch=4 -> fused_attn (lat 48ms)
[12:04:42] kvcache: hit_rate=0.92 miss=8%
[12:05:10] queue_depth=170 batch_candidate=8 -> choose_kernel: fallback_attn (lat 210ms)
[12:05:12] p99=740ms p95=260ms
[12:05:40] choose_kernel: fused_attn (lat 50ms)
[12:05:41] p99=220ms
```

sam: note how kernel choice flips within ~30s during a sustained queue increase.

infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaled runtime-pool from 10 -> 14 replicas (reason: queue_depth > 300)

tess: admission control currently throttles based on a util threshold but we don't have hysteresis for kernel selection. adding a short require-stable-window before switching kernels might help.

corey: agreed. kernel flips are expensive — cache warmup + fallback kernels blow up latency. we should prefer stability over marginal perf wins under load.

nisha: prefetching KV for top prefixes reduces miss tail spikes but increases memory pressure. tradeoff: fewer p99 spikes vs less headroom. another lever: cap microbatch at 4 when util > 75% to protect tail.

liam: proposed admission heuristic: if gpu_util > 80% AND p99 > 500ms -> set max_microbatch=4, increase kv_prefetch_window to 2s, and enable kernel_hysteresis (require 2 consecutive windows to flip). also add 60s cooldown after action.

sam: +1 on that. we need an AB to validate. i'll spin canary with those flags for 1h on ~10% traffic.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime/canary-2026-03-18-09 with flags {max_microbatch:4, kv_prefetch:2s, kernel_hysteresis:2, cooldown:60s}. ETA ~2m

tess: also want a new metric: `kernel_flips_per_min` and `kv_miss_tail_95` to datadog, so we can alert on flip storms.

liam: i'll add the counters and a tiny PR to runtime to emit `kernel_selection_change` events (lightweight).

sam: ok scheduling canary in 10m. no objection to 60s cooldown? :thumbsup:

nisha: no objections. go for it.

corey: if this helps on the tail we should bake the heuristic into default admission and add a config knob for enterprise customers.

sam: thanks all — i'll post results in this thread after the canary (will include p95/p99, gpu_util, kv_hit_rate, kernel_flips).

liam: thanks — if it regresses we can roll back quickly.

sam: (reaction :eyes: )
